product.name: Chatbot & Support
product.description: A website chat launcher and window, AI replies through the merchant's own AI provider, knowledge from FAQs and pages, conversation flows, tools, a human inbox with handoff, proactive messages, lead capture, CSAT, transcripts and moderation — all data in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Chat window
elements.description: Conversations and messages: the drop-in chat window (bubble, side panel or full screen on mobile), its headless core with polling, and the conversations REST API. Guests get a marker token; signed-in customers are identified by the website's own login (SS-Identity).

elements.name: Launcher
elements.description: The floating chat button: position, offset, size, icon, label, pulse, unread badge, hide rules and open triggers (delay, scroll, exit intent, idle, selector click).

elements.name: AI replies
elements.description: Replies generated by the merchant's own AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint through the AI connector): persona, instructions, language lock, tool rounds, timeouts, per-conversation and monthly token budgets. Metered in AI tokens.

elements.name: Knowledge
elements.description: FAQ entries and web pages (fetched safely, chunked into the merchant database) retrieved by keyword relevance (BM25) to ground AI answers; per-source priority, refresh and a configurable "don't know" behaviour.

elements.name: Conversation flows
elements.description: Visual-builder-ready conversation graphs: message, question, buttons, form, condition (rules@1), action, AI step and handoff nodes with variables and triggers (start, keyword, page, event).

elements.name: Tools
elements.description: Built-in tools (order status from the order events, knowledge search, escalation) and merchant webhook tools with a typed input schema, called with signed requests through the SSRF guard. Metered per call.

elements.name: Inbox
elements.description: Human agents and teams: assignment (manual, round-robin, least loaded, rules), working hours, SLAs with breach tracking, statuses, priorities, tags, canned replies, internal notes and snooze — in the dashboard, headless or by API.

elements.name: Handoff
elements.description: When the conversation goes to a person (escalation phrases, a rules@1 condition, repeated AI failures, a flow or the AI itself), to which team, what the customer sees, the offline fallback and when the AI may resume.

elements.name: Proactive messages
elements.description: Targeted messages by rule (page, cart value, returning visitor, time) with frequency caps and dismissal memory.

elements.name: Lead capture
elements.description: Collect contact details when nobody is available (or always): configurable fields, consent, stored in the merchant database and published as chatbot.lead_captured@1.

elements.name: CSAT
elements.description: Customer satisfaction: rating scale, when it is asked, an optional comment and the target score.

elements.name: Transcripts
elements.description: Retention of conversations and messages (TTL), transcript export as JSON or text for the merchant and, optionally, the customer.

elements.name: Moderation
elements.description: PII redaction in and out (cards, IBANs, e-mails, phones, IPs), the leak filter for AI replies (secrets, prompt internals), a link policy and blocked terms.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Launcher, window, AI replies with knowledge, handoff with lead capture, moderation; tools, proactive messages, CSAT and transcripts as add-ons.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: Everything: flows, tools, the human inbox, proactive messages, CSAT and transcripts, with higher bounds.
